name: Center3 Buraydah / STC Al-Qassim Data Center
notes: STC launched a new approximately 12,000 sqm data center in Al-Qassim; Baxtel identifies center3's NEIDC-Qassim facility as located in Buraydah and built in 2022.

name: Center3 Dammam Data Center / Dammam352
notes: center3 announced its Dammam facility as a 24,000 sqm Tier 3 site with 8 data halls, 1,200 racks and 19.5 MW total power; Baxtel lists Dammam352 as operational.

name: Center3 Dammam21
notes: Baxtel lists Center3 Dammam21 as a fully operational Dammam metro facility; center3's site confirms Dammam is one of its Saudi data-center locations.

name: DDC307 Data Center
developer: Digital Data Centers for Data and Telecommunications Company (Center3)
notes: solutions signed an SAR 364 million contract with Center3 on August 3, 2026 to establish, build and prepare DDC307 in Dammam; reported schedule is 18 months.

name: DAMAC Digital / EDGNEX Dammam Data Center
notes: SALFO describes DAMAC's Dammam campus as a phased 30 MW master plan with 10 MW IT load and Tier III design/construction certification; Baxtel lists Edgnex Dammam as operational, built 2024.

name: Khazna Dammam Campus / DMM1
notes: Khazna announced acquisition of a 225,000 sqm Dammam land plot and plans for up to 200 MW of AI-ready capacity; Baxtel lists Khazna Dammam DMM1 under construction.

name: Humain Dammam AI Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists Humain's Dammam facility as under construction, planned in 2026, with 100 MW and expected Q2 2026 launch; DCD reports Humain/Infra financing for 250 MW of Saudi capacity.

name: ICS Arabia Desert Dragon Data Center - Dammam location
developer: ICS Arabia / Desert Dragon Data Centers
notes: ICS Arabia describes Desert Dragon as a $1.9B, 187 MW, four-location Saudi data-center program including Dammam; site-specific MW was not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Saudi Arabia East Cloud Region
notes: Microsoft confirmed its Saudi Arabia East datacenter region in the Eastern Province will include three availability zones and be available from Q4 2026; Infra's public post says the contracted facility is in Dammam.

name: Mobily Al-Ahsa Data Center
notes: Arab News reported the Al-Ahsa deputy governor opened Mobily's technical/data center in Al-Ahsa; the center provided 560 sqm of dedicated space with expansion potential to 1,200 sqm and Tier II-oriented uptime/business-continuity design.

name: SABIC Jubail Main Building Data Center
notes: Shapoorji Pallonji lists the SABIC Jubail Main Building as ongoing and including a data centre; Dar Al Riyadh describes the Jubail facility as including a mixed Tier II + Tier IV data center.

name: Center3 Al Khobar Data Center
notes: center3 announced the AlKhobar facility as 35,000 sqm, 24.4 MW, 10 data halls and up to 1,500 racks; Baxtel lists the site as operational with future phases planned.
